subtitle.pt: Curta de stop motion com puppet de armadura e set construído à mão
subtitle.en: Stop motion short with an armature puppet and a hand-built set

summary.pt: Plano de mesa de 40 segundos animado a 12 fps sobre 2, com puppet de armadura de alumínio e set de 40 cm. Captura em Dragonframe, som desenhado em Reaper.
summary.en: A 40-second tabletop shot animated on twos at 12 fps, with an aluminium armature puppet and a 40 cm set. Captured in Dragonframe, sound designed in Reaper.

en.heading: Brief and constraints
en.text: One continuous tabletop shot, no cuts, told without dialogue. The constraint that mattered was physical: the set had to fit on a 40 cm board and the puppet had to survive 480 frames of handling without the armature loosening.

en.heading: The problem
en.text: The puppet's hand kept drifting between frames because the armature had no friction at the wrist. I replaced the wrist joint with a tie-down and animated the hand as a separate replacement piece for the three frames where it holds the tool.

en.heading: What I would do differently
en.text: Shoot a full lighting test on the final set before animating. I lost half a day to a flicker caused by a lamp on a dimmer circuit.
